headline: Binance Reports $3.64 Billion in Outflows Following Token Theft
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance experienced $3.64 billion in customer outflows and resumed normal transactions following a $6.3 billion token theft linked to North Korea.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume; massive withdrawals and security breaches can trigger severe liquidity pressures and broader crypto market volatility.
why_moved: A multi-billion dollar token theft and massive customer withdrawals raise systemic concerns over exchange solvency and market liquidity.
